name: Atlassian Loom
description: Loom is Atlassian's asynchronous video-messaging product for recording and sharing screen, camera, and audio walkthroughs.
agentUseSummary: Atlassian Loom cannot be connected as an agent provider because Atlassian states that Loom has no open account API; recordSDK and embedSDK are interactive product-embedding tools rather than delegated account automation.

blocked.label: Connect a Loom account
blocked.description: Atlassian Loom does not provide a supported OAuth or account API for delegated agent access.

blocked.label: Use Loom account data
blocked.description: Atlassian does not publish an open API for reading or changing Loom videos, folders, comments, or workspace data.

blocked.label: Run Loom agent actions
blocked.description: Loom SDK embeds interactive recording and playback UI; it is not an account automation API.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported Atlassian Loom account API.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported Atlassian Loom account API is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported Atlassian Loom account API is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Atlassian's current Loom support documentation states that Loom does not offer an open API and that Loom SDK does not provide API functionality.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Atlassian Loom only if Atlassian publishes a supported account API or remote MCP service for delegated automation.

evidence.supports: Atlassian states that Loom does not offer an open API and that Loom SDK is not an open API and does not provide the same functionality as APIs.
The official SDK FAQ describes interactive browser recording authenticated with a developer API key, not delegated account or workspace automation.
Loom's developer portal exposes recordSDK and embedSDK for interactive recording and playback experiences, not an account automation API.
